topic: Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 credit card at 24% APR takes over 20 years and roughly doubles what you owe
title: Why Minimum Payments Double Your Credit Card Debt
description:
Paying only the minimum on a $5,000 credit card can take over 20 years and cost you thousands in interest. We show you the math that banks use to keep you in debt.
